package service

// Loaded into Sub2 with `go test -overlay`; never copied into its checkout.
// KKAI_CAPTURE_DIR selects the NewAPI fixture directory.
import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestCaptureNewAPIRecoveryFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("KKAI_CAPTURE_DIR")
	require.NotEmpty(t, dir)
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		mode    OpenAIRecoveryWireFormat
		request string
	}{
		{"responses_auto_dispatch", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"responses_reasoning_recovery", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"responses_terminal_only", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"chat_multi", OpenAIRecoveryChatSSE, `{"n":2}`},
		{"chat_strict", OpenAIRecoveryChatSSE, `{"response_format":{"type":"json_object"}}`},
		{"chat_tool_failure", OpenAIRecoveryChatSSE, `{"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"lookup","parameters":{"type":"object"}}}]}`},
		{"responses_strict", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{"text":{"format":{"type":"json_object"}}}`},
		{"responses_tool_failure", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{"tools":[{"type":"function","name":"lookup","parameters":{"type":"object"}}]}`},
		{"responses_abandoned_failure", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"responses_exhausted", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"responses_refusal_recovery", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"responses_strict_refusal", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{"text":{"format":{"type":"json_object"}}}`},
		{"responses_strict_refusal_done_only", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{"text":{"format":{"type":"json_object"}}}`},
		{"responses_refusal_partial_done", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{"text":{"format":{"type":"json_object"}}}`},
		{"responses_refusal_item_snapshot", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"responses_multi_part_recovery", OpenAIRecoveryResponsesSSE, `{}`},
		{"chat_strict_refusal", OpenAIRecoveryChatSSE, `{"response_format":{"type":"json_object"}}`},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
			c, _ := gin.CreateTestContext(recorder)
			w := NewOpenAIRecoveryStreamWriter(c.Writer, tc.mode, "logical_capture_"+tc.name, []byte(tc.request), nil)
			ctx := WithOpenAIManagedRecovery(context.Background())
			ctx = WithOpenAIModelDispatchBudget(ctx)
			ctx = WithOpenAIModelDispatchObserver(ctx, w.BeginAttempt)
			dispatch := func() { require.NoError(t, takeOpenAIModelDispatch(ctx, 1)) }
			write := func(data string) { _, err := w.WriteString("data: " + data + "\n\n"); require.NoError(t, err) }
			dispatch()
			switch tc.name {
			case "chat_tool_failure":
				write(`{"id":"chat_tool","object":"chat.completion.chunk","model":"gpt-test","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_one","type":"function","function":{"name":"lookup","arguments":"{\"q\":"}}]},"finish_reason":null}]}`)
				require.True(t, w.PublicToolOutputStarted())
				require.NoError(t, w.FailAttempt("upstream_error", "rate_limit_exceeded", "rate limited"))
			case "responses_tool_failure":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_tool","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"fc_upstream","type":"function_call","call_id":"call_one","name":"lookup","arguments":"","status":"in_progress"}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.function_call_arguments.delta","output_index":0,"item_id":"fc_upstream","delta":"{\"q\":"}`)
				require.True(t, w.PublicToolOutputStarted())
				require.NoError(t, w.FailAttempt("upstream_error", "rate_limit_exceeded", "rate limited"))
			case "responses_auto_dispatch", "responses_abandoned_failure", "responses_reasoning_recovery":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_old","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_old","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_old","part":{"type":"output_text","text":"","annotations":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_text.delta","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_old","delta":"abandoned text"}`)
				if tc.name == "responses_reasoning_recovery" {
					write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":1,"item":{"id":"reason_old","type":"reasoning","summary":[]}}`)
					write(`{"type":"response.reasoning_summary_part.added","output_index":1,"summary_index":0,"item_id":"reason_old","part":{"type":"summary_text","text":""}}`)
					write(`{"type":"response.reasoning_summary_text.delta","output_index":1,"summary_index":0,"item_id":"reason_old","delta":"old summary"}`)
					write(`{"type":"response.output_item.done","output_index":1,"item":{"id":"reason_old","type":"reasoning","summary":[{"type":"summary_text","text":"old summary"}],"encrypted_content":"abandoned cipher"}}`)
				}
				if tc.name == "responses_abandoned_failure" {
					require.NoError(t, w.AbandonAttempt())
					require.NoError(t, w.FailAttempt("upstream_error", "recovery_exhausted", "No eligible upstream account"))
					break
				}
				dispatch() // Exercises automatic Abandon from the physical dispatch observer.
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_new","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_new","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_new","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"winner text","annotations":[]}]}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3,"total_tokens":5}}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_terminal_only":
				dispatch() // No public business frames from the abandoned first dispatch.
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_new","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_new","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_new","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"winner text","annotations":[]}]}]}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_strict_refusal", "responses_refusal_recovery":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_refusal","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_refusal","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal","part":{"type":"refusal","refusal":""}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.refusal.delta","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal","delta":"cannot comply"}`)
				if tc.name == "responses_refusal_recovery" {
					dispatch()
					write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_new","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_new","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"winner text","annotations":[]}]}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3,"total_tokens":5}}}`)
				} else {
					write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_refusal","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_refusal","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"cannot comply"}]}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3,"total_tokens":5}}}`)
				}
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_strict_refusal_done_only":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_refusal_done","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_refusal_done","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal_done","part":{"type":"refusal","refusal":""}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.refusal.done","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal_done","refusal":"cannot comply"}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_refusal_done","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_refusal_done","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"cannot comply"}]}]}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_refusal_partial_done":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_refusal_parts","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_refusal_parts","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal_parts","part":{"type":"refusal","refusal":""}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.refusal.delta","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal_parts","delta":"cannot"}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.refusal.done","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_refusal_parts","refusal":"cannot comply"}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":1,"item_id":"msg_refusal_parts","part":{"type":"refusal","refusal":""}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.refusal.done","output_index":0,"content_index":1,"item_id":"msg_refusal_parts","refusal":" with that request"}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_refusal_parts","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_refusal_parts","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"cannot comply"},{"type":"refusal","refusal":" with that request"}]}]}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_refusal_item_snapshot":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_snapshot","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_snapshot","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"cannot comply"}]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.done","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_snapshot","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"cannot comply"}]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_snapshot","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_snapshot","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"cannot comply"}]}]}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_multi_part_recovery":
				write(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_old","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_old","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_old","part":{"type":"output_text","text":"","annotations":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_text.delta","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_old","delta":"abandoned text"}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.output_text.done","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_old","text":"abandoned text"}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.done","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_old","part":{"type":"output_text","text":"abandoned text","annotations":[]}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":1,"item_id":"msg_old","part":{"type":"refusal","refusal":""}}`)
				write(`{"type":"response.refusal.delta","output_index":0,"content_index":1,"item_id":"msg_old","delta":"old refusal"}`)
				dispatch()
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_new","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_new","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"winner text","annotations":[]}]}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3,"total_tokens":5}}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "chat_strict_refusal":
				write(`{"id":"chat_refusal","model":"gpt-test","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","refusal":"cannot comply"},"finish_reason":null}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_refusal","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_refusal","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":0,"completion_tokens":0,"total_tokens":0}}`)
				write(`[DONE]`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_exhausted":
				for attempt := 1; attempt <= 11; attempt++ {
					write(fmt.Sprintf(`{"type":"response.created","response":{"id":"resp_%d","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-test","output":[]}}`, attempt))
					write(fmt.Sprintf(`{"type":"response.output_item.added","output_index":0,"item":{"id":"msg_%d","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"in_progress","content":[]}}`, attempt))
					write(fmt.Sprintf(`{"type":"response.content_part.added","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_%d","part":{"type":"output_text","text":"","annotations":[]}}`, attempt))
					write(fmt.Sprintf(`{"type":"response.output_text.delta","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"item_id":"msg_%d","delta":"partial attempt"}`, attempt))
					if attempt < 11 {
						dispatch()
					}
				}
				require.NoError(t, w.AbandonAttempt())
				require.NoError(t, w.FailAttempt("upstream_error", "recovery_exhausted", "All eleven attempts were exhausted"))
			case "chat_multi":
				write(`{"id":"chat_old","object":"chat.completion.chunk","model":"gpt-test","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"abandoned zero"},"finish_reason":null},{"index":1,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"abandoned one"},"finish_reason":null}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_old","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`)
				write(`[DONE]`)
				require.Error(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
				dispatch()
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","object":"chat.completion.chunk","model":"gpt-test","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"winner zero"},"finish_reason":null},{"index":1,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"winner one"},"finish_reason":null}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","choices":[{"index":1,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":4,"completion_tokens":6,"total_tokens":10}}`)
				write(`[DONE]`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "chat_strict":
				write(`{"id":"chat_old","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"invalid JSON"},"finish_reason":null}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_old","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`)
				write(`[DONE]`)
				require.Error(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
				require.Empty(t, recorder.Body.String())
				dispatch()
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","model":"gpt-test","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"{\"ok\":true}"},"finish_reason":null}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`)
				write(`{"id":"chat_new","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":0,"completion_tokens":0,"total_tokens":0}}`)
				write(`[DONE]`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			case "responses_strict":
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_old","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_old","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"invalid JSON","annotations":[]}]}]}}`)
				require.Error(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
				require.Empty(t, recorder.Body.String())
				dispatch()
				write(`{"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_new","model":"gpt-test","status":"completed","output":[{"id":"msg_new","type":"message","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"{\"ok\":true}","annotations":[]}]}]}}`)
				require.NoError(t, w.CommitAttempt(""))
			}
			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, tc.name+".sse"), recorder.Body.Bytes(), 0644))
		})
	}
}
